faqs.q: Can I choose my own transport?
faqs.a: Yes. Tell us what you prefer and we adapt the plan. If you have no preference, we recommend the best option for each leg.
Fuel, driver and tolls are always included in the quote. Meals are only included when the trip description says so.

faqs.q: How much luggage can I bring?
faqs.a: One suitcase and one small bag per person is the standard. Domestic flights have stricter weight limits, and we tell you the exact allowance when you book.

faqs.q: Is it safe to travel by road?
faqs.a: Our drivers are selected and trained by us, and we avoid night driving on difficult routes. We adapt schedules to road and weather conditions.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel a booking?
faqs.a: You can change dates free of charge up to 7 days before departure, subject to availability. Cancellation terms depend on the service and are shown in your quote.
Yes. A driver waits for you at arrivals with a sign, even if your flight is delayed.
